verdict.rationale: Belvo's docs center data retrieval on a single link object. Developers filter List requests by `link.id`, and one link yields transaction history, account balances and investment details. Recurrent links refresh that data automatically, which suggests one connection feeds several resources. However, no doc explicitly says one Connect session covers all products without a separate flow per product. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that one widget session serves multiple products, evidence covering identity/owner and auth data from the same link, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, one link session can power multiple data products — auth, balances, transactions, identity — without forcing the user through separate connection flows per product

citations.quote: We strongly recommend that you use the `link` query parameter in your List requests so that you only receive results for a given `link.id`.
Retrieve transaction history, account balances, and investment details seamlessly.
Removes the need for POST calls after link creation to retrieve core information about the link.
With recurrent links, Belvo automatically refreshes information weekly and notifies you via webhook so you always have up-to-date data.
